"""Daily SPO+ Top3 selection regret and mixed validation metric, experiment scope."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import rankdata

def bounds(index):
    dt=index.get_level_values('datetime').to_numpy()
    return np.r_[0,np.flatnonzero(dt[1:]!=dt[:-1])+1,len(dt)]

def members(scores):
    """Expected inclusion probabilities of a strict, equally weighted Top3."""
    n=len(scores);cut=np.partition(scores,n-3)[n-3]
    idx=np.flatnonzero(scores>=cut);above=scores[idx]>cut
    prob=np.ones(len(idx),dtype=float)
    prob[~above]=(3-above.sum())/(~above).sum()
    return idx,prob

class RegretGradient:
    def __init__(self,index,grade,raw,weights):
        self.grade=grade;self.weights=weights;self.z=np.empty(len(raw),dtype=np.float64)
        self.windows=[];vol=[]
        for lo,hi in zip(bounds(index)[:-1],bounds(index)[1:]):
            y=raw[lo:hi];sd=y.std();assert sd>0 and np.isfinite(y).all()
            vol.append(sd);z=(y-y.mean())/sd;self.z[lo:hi]=z;idx,p=members(z)
            self.windows.append((lo,hi,idx,p))
        self.scale=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(vol))))
        self.hessian=weights.astype('float32')
    def __call__(self,scores,dataset):
        g=np.asarray(scores-self.grade,dtype='float64')
        adversary=2*scores-self.z
        for lo,hi,idx,p in self.windows:
            other,q=members(adversary[lo:hi]);factor=(.2/.8)*2*np.sqrt(3*(hi-lo))/3
            day=g[lo:hi];day[other]+=factor*q;day[idx]-=factor*p
        return np.asarray(g*self.weights,dtype='float32'),self.hessian

class MixedMetric:
    def __init__(self,valid,context,scale):
        self.scale=scale;self.index=valid.index;self.info=[];self.reverse_checked=False
        dt=valid.index.get_level_values('datetime')
        for lo,hi in zip(bounds(valid.index)[:-1],bounds(valid.index)[1:]):
            date=dt[lo];own=context.own.iloc[lo];before=int(context.prev.iloc[lo])
            ranks=None
            if own:
                y=rankdata(valid['label','LABEL0'].to_numpy()[lo:hi])
                y-=y.mean();ranks=y/np.linalg.norm(y)
            keep=np.flatnonzero(context.tradable.to_numpy()[lo:hi])
            assert len(keep)>=3
            ids=valid.index.codes[valid.index.names.index('instrument')][lo:hi][keep]
            self.info.append((lo,hi,keep,ids,context.raw.to_numpy()[lo:hi][keep],ranks,before,date))
        self.positions={v[-1]:i for i,v in enumerate(self.info)}
    def compute(self,pred,reverse=False):
        portfolios=[];returns=[];ics=[];turn=[];ties=0
        for lo,hi,keep,ids,raw,target,previous,date in self.info:
            s=pred[lo:hi];x=s[keep]
            if reverse:x=x[::-1];ids=ids[::-1];raw=raw[::-1]
            jj,p=members(x);chosen=ids[jj]
            if target is not None:
                ranks=rankdata(s[::-1] if reverse else s);ranks-=ranks.mean()
                norm=np.linalg.norm(ranks)
                if norm:ics.append((ranks@(target[::-1] if reverse else target))/norm)
                returns.append(float((raw[jj]@p)/3));ties+=int(len(p)>3)
                if previous>=0:
                    oldids,oldp=portfolios[previous]
                    _,i,j=np.intersect1d(chosen,oldids,assume_unique=True,return_indices=True)
                    turn.append(1-p[i]@oldp[j]/3)
            portfolios.append((chosen,p))
        gross=float(np.mean(returns));to=float(np.mean(turn));net=gross-.00092*to;ic=float(np.mean(ics))
        return dict(ic=ic,gross_h5=gross,turnover=to,net_h5=net,mixed=.8*ic+.2*net/self.scale,top3_tie_days=int(ties),n=len(returns),n_ic=len(ics))
